name: TU Delft Quantum 101
description: Quantum 101: Quantum Computing & Quantum Internet is a Professional Certificate program offered by TU Delft on edX. The program covers quantum hardware fundamentals, quantum algorithms, quantum internet protocols, and hands-on exercises with Quantum Inspire. Developed by researchers at QuTech, the courses are free to audit with an optional paid certificate.
